translation_notes: Two sibling loops `for i in self.state.subjects(KTBS.p, self.uri)` -> `for i in m{ ?i ktbs:p {self.uri} }`, with `@graph self.state` once. The iteration value is a bare term (arity 1) so the body is unchanged. Not fused: the two predicates feed two independent sets of messages (hasMethod then hasParentMethod); a join would require both.

KTBS comes from the project (`from ..namespace import KTBS`), so `from ktbs_context import ktbs:` imports the prefix (the shim defines KTBS, read under the prefix's upper-cased name). original.py is edited only on that import line (`from ..namespace import KTBS` -> `from ktbs_context import KTBS, Method`, Method being the class the region names in `super(Method, self)`); translated.ldpy imports Method the same way.

Context shim ktbs_context.py: the KTBS namespace IRI of lib/ktbs/namespace.py (a ClosedNamespace there, a plain Namespace here), rdfrest.util.Diagnosis verbatim minus the & operators, LocalCore.check_deletable (the default Diagnosis) as the superclass method, and a Method with uri + state. Sources fetched with gh at ktbs/ktbs@4f9f50c770 (rdfrest is in the repository at that tag).

Driver: 5 calls (m1 used both ways; m2 through hasMethod only, by a trace and by a method; m3 parent only; m4 used by nothing, whose own outgoing hasParentMethod/hasMethod and look-alike predicates must not count; an unknown method). The Diagnosis instance is compared attribute by attribute, its messages as a multiset. Verified by mutation (subject/object swapped in the second pattern, second predicate replaced by hasMethod): check FAILS.
optimization_notes: optimized.py: the two sibling loops, which differ only by the predicate and the predicate's name in the message, become one loop over `("hasMethod", "hasParentMethod")` with `KTBS[prop]` and the name formatted into the message. The messages are byte-identical and come in the same order (every hasMethod user, then every hasParentMethod user). `%` formatting is kept: an f-string is longer in tokens on Python 3.12.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `m{ ?i ktbs:{prop} {self.uri} }` with a computed local part, under `@graph self.state` (two tokens fewer than a call suffix on the single island; with the suffix the island only ties with `self.state.subjects(KTBS[prop], self.uri)`). No exception to the symmetry rule.
header_optimization_notes: Nothing unused in either header (KTBS/ktbs: and Method are both used, there is no @prefix line): optimized_header.py and optimized_header.ldpy are copies of the optimized artefacts.
